verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents first-party AI coding agent plugins that add Connector SDK skills to Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and GitHub Copilot CLI, letting users build, test, and deploy custom Python connectors from natural-language prompts. The evidence does not show the AI drafting from API documentation specifically, or handling auth, pagination, and streams. Missing for 10: evidence of drafting directly from API documentation, explicit auth/pagination/stream generation, a documented review-before-ship workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts a working connector from API documentation — auth, pagination, streams — that I review and ship

citations.quote: We provide AI coding agent plugins that add Connector SDK-specific skills to Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and GitHub Copilot CLI. These skills let you build, test, and deploy connectors using natural language prompts.
Fivetran’s Connector SDK allows you to develop a custom data connector using Python and deploy it as an extension of Fivetran.
